status: curated public evidence and declared coordinates for a parametric ADR transient-cycle envelope
model_boundary: No NBCP device has been built, so no addenda, ramp, heat-switch, or regeneration loss is assigned as a measured NBCP value.
Transient losses are represented by declared fractions of gross magnetic capacity and are used only to expose design margins.
The component allocation among addenda, ramp, and switching is bookkeeping for sensitivity analysis, not a probability distribution or a transferred material property.
Published devices differ in refrigerant, temperature, geometry, thermal interfaces, and architecture; their timing and load values are context anchors only.
Warm-side heat rejection cannot be inferred from the cold magnetic budget and is reported only as a missing device-level closure quantity.
